scale.description: Engine-units multiplicative per-entity visual factor; 1 is neutral. Not the collision hitbox size or item.worldScale: projectile draw scale multiplies hitbox.drawScale separately. no_asset entities may have no visible sprite.

forwardAngleDegrees.description: Finite local forward-axis angle of the final PNG after crop/fit/padding, before facing/gravity flips. Degrees: 0=+X (right), positive clockwise in y-down image coordinates. Describes the authored pixels, not AI movement or a gameplay rotation override. The main-PNG renderer subtracts this local axis from body-forward automatically: changing it cannot cancel rotation.offsetRadians. Draw the declared axis literally; no image/prose inference.

grip.description: Atomic hand pivot on the selected final PNG canvas after crop/fit/padding, before facing/gravity flips. normalizedX=0 is left, 1 right; normalizedY=0 top, 1 bottom. Both required; no pixel units or gameplay geometry. Optional except for sprite-consuming attachment.anchor=front_hand or retained move_front_hand; armPose alone does not require it. Root/reuse select the single item grip; only distinct baked entities own an entity grip. Not authored HoldoutOffset.

preferredCanvasSize.description: Requested square independent entity PNG target canvas, in pixels per side; not the item's world size or a guaranteed on-screen display size.

renderSizePx.description: Base world-pixel length of the larger side of the complete final PNG frame, before rotation/camera and independent draw multipliers. Not alpha-bbox, collision, inventory fit or bake resolution. Runtime uses q=renderSizePx/max(actual final frame width,height).

geometry.description: Explicit untextured solid body. body_segment is centered on the entity; collision_path follows only an existing accepted beam/lash centerline. Does not alter gameplay. No inferred dimensions, color, opacity or axis.

axis.description: Use velocity (initial direction at zero speed), literal runtime rotation, or accepted aim axis. aim requires an aim component; no movement-code routing.

color.description: Literal RGB color; not inherited from entity light.

lengthPx.description: Centered segment length in world pixels, independent of hitbox and projectile/visual scale.

widthPx.description: Solid strip width in world pixels, independent of collision width, projectile/visual scale and light.

entityIndicesDelete.description: Zero-based array index values into the previous entities array to delete; structural positions, not time or size.

accessoryMount.description: Optional accessory-only body-local badge anchor, using the existing overlay PNG, body pivot/rotation and 18px fit. chest=(0,-2), back=(-10,-4), waist=(0,10), shoulder=(8,-12) player pixels relative to center, X facing-mirrored and Y gravity-mirrored. orbit uses the existing accessory slot ring. Armor ignores this field. No atlas or gameplay change.
